description.value: The Kerrisdale Branch is one of the neighbourhood branches of the Vancouver Public Library system, serving the quiet residential Kerrisdale district in southwest Vancouver. OSM data indicates it is situated on a lower level (level -1), suggesting it occupies a basement or below-grade space within its building. As a public library, it offers a welcoming rest stop for touring cyclists passing through the area, with free Wi-Fi noted in OSM.
